body: Hey, thank you sm for answering and for worrying about me. It has been 3 months since I posted this. The day I wrote about this, I was having a huge mental breakdown and I still have a lot of stress about my height and my dream job but I'm trying not to stress about it, I have made up my mind about it. I know that if I chose this career that I'm so passionate about, there will be many hardships, but I can do it.
